exposure: Patients who tried to conceive after RPRM
Reduced-port robotic myomectomy (RPRM) using Da Vinci(®) Xi™
outcome: Fertility outcomes (e.g., pregnancy rate, live birth rate)
Obstetric outcomes (e.g., mode of delivery, complications)
cohort: 401 patients who underwent RPRM by a single operator between October 2017 and October 2021
finding: RPRM using the Da Vinci Xi system is a feasible and safe surgical option for patients with symptomatic uterine myomas who desire future fertility, demonstrating favorable surgical, fertility, and obstetric outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the primary mode of delivery for patients who conceived after RPRM (97.7%).
